entities.name: Shadow Gate
entities.description: An artifact of Kamigawa that allowed travel from one shadow to another, later bound to Toshi's body as a kanji.

entities.name: Uramon
entities.description: Was given the Shadow Gate by the Myojin of Night's Reach.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: Kami who gave the Gate to Uramon and later bound it to Toshi.

entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: Stole the Shadow Gate and, with it, That Which Was Taken from Konda.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Victim of Toshi's theft of That Which Was Taken.

entities.name: That Which Was Taken
entities.description: Item stolen from Konda by Toshi.

entities.name: Tetsuko Umezawa
entities.description: Toshi's descendant who practices a similar magic.

events.summary: The Myojin of Night's Reach gave the Shadow Gate to Uramon; it was later stolen by Toshi Umezawa.
events.quote: It was given to Uramon by the Myojin of Night's Reach and later stolen by Toshi Umezawa .

events.summary: Night bound the Gate to Toshi's body as a kanji on his chest.
events.quote: Night bound the Gate to Toshi's body by turning it into a kanji on his chest.

events.summary: The Gate enabled Toshi to steal That Which Was Taken from Konda.
events.quote: the Shadow Gate made it possible for Toshi to steal That Which Was Taken from Konda .

relations.quote: Toshi's descendant Tetsuko Umezawa practices a similar magic.
